title: data for billing.balance_added
description: Money entered the integrator's BRL wallet: a confirmed top-up, a top-up bonus or trial promotional balance, an opening balance or a positive operator adjustment. Envelope business_id and channel_id are null.

amount_micros.description: Amount added. Integer string in micros (R$ 1 = "1000000").

balance_micros.description: Wallet balance after the entry. Integer string in micros (R$ 1 = "1000000").

available_micros.description: Available after the entry. Integer string in micros (R$ 1 = "1000000").

topup_id.description: Top-up that originated the entry (topup and campaign bonus).
